answer_2.quote: We evaluate the model with objective metrics including cosine distance (SECS), character error rate (CER), word error rate (WER) for zero-shot voice conversion, and emotion score from a pre-trained emotion representation model for style transfer. Inference latency is measured by the real-time factor (RTF) on a single NVIDIA V100 GPU. ... We also compute speaking rate as phonemes per second (PPS) ...

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 200 emotional speech samples ... MOS assessments are conducted via Amazon Mechanical Turk, focusing on QMOS (quality, clarity, naturalness) and SMOS (speaker similarity)... For QMOS evaluations, the listeners are instructed to focus on assessing the audio quality and naturalness while disregarding any differences in styles... For SMOS evaluations, the listeners are instructed to concentrate on evaluating the speaker similarity to the audio prompt.
answer_4.guideline: Listeners rate each sample on a Likert scale (1‑5) for quality, clarity, naturalness (QMOS) and for speaker similarity (SMOS).
